comment: Checklist B of #503: every implemented material on every material-bearing representation, light and dark background, Metal ray tracing off and on. Regenerate with render.py; build the page with gallery.py. See docs/materials.md.

show: m and polymer and not hydro
m and polymer and not hydro

lock_check.comment: Procedural patterns must stay locked to the object. Rendered orthoscopic at a view and at the same view panned; a locked pattern moves with the silhouette, a swimming one does not.

comment_colour: colour and extra are Python statements run with cmd and util in scope.

degrades_to_default.comment: Clear and frosted glass are excluded from sphere impostors by a deliberate scope line (Material.cpp, MaterialResolve) and draw as default there; jelly draws (#526). The gallery shows them and does not flag them.

rt_invariant.comment: Transparent geometry is not in the Metal ray-traced scene unless metal_rt_transparent is on (#532; off by default and in the gallery), so these render identically with metal_raytrace 0 and 1; expected, not flagged.

expected_identical_pairs.comment: Under material_env 0 the room IS the background; a near-black room reflects nothing, and reflection is the only term in which plastic and metallic differ. With ray tracing on, or on a light background, or under material_env 1, they differ. Documented in docs/materials.md.
